import pandas as pd
path='sahyog_budget_and_receipts.xlsx'
df=pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name='Finance FY25-26', header=None)
# Find header row
header_idx = df[df[0]=='B. DONOR RECEIPTS — CREDITS CLEARED APR–SEP 2025'].index[0]
col_header_idx = header_idx+1
data_start = col_header_idx+1
# Extract columns
cols = df.iloc[col_header_idx].tolist()
# Get data rows until TOTAL RECEIPTS
sub = df.iloc[data_start:].copy()
sub = sub[sub[0]"'!='"'TOTAL RECEIPTS']
# Build dataframe
data = []
for i in range(data_start, len(df)):
    row = df.iloc[i]
    if pd.isna(row[0]) or row[0]=='TOTAL RECEIPTS':
        break
    data.append(row.tolist())
# Use first row as header?
# Let's just parse manually
receipts = []
for i in range(data_start, len(df)):
    r = df.iloc[i,0]
    if pd.isna(r) or r=='TOTAL RECEIPTS':
        break
    receipts.append({
        'Receipt ID': df.iloc[i,0],
        'Credit Date': df.iloc[i,1],
        'Donor / Scheme': df.iloc[i,2],
        'Donor Type': df.iloc[i,3],
        'Programme Tagged': df.iloc[i,4],
    })
import pandas as pd
r_df = pd.DataFrame(receipts)
print(r_df)
print('Distinct count', r_df[r_df['Donor Type']=='Foreign Grant']['Receipt ID'].nunique())
print(r_df[r_df['Donor Type']=='Foreign Grant']['Receipt ID'].tolist())
